levels.descriptor: Low power aimed flat, and only the Drive owner.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One of the two picks is right.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Both wrong, or no picks.

criterion: The rules: Knows where to test and who types where

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Two named launchers (a team number, product name or linked build), each with one specific feature to copy or avoid.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One named launcher, or a general type ("a pitching machine") with no name, or nothing specific taken.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No launchers named.

criterion: Your concept sketch: Research: two real launchers named (a team, product or build that can be found), with what the student will copy or avoid from each

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Top and side view; the ball's path drawn; the frame, the wheel or arm, the drive and the ball path each have a size and a process.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One view only, or the path missing, or any of those four parts without a size or a process.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No sketch, or not a launcher.

criterion: Your concept sketch: Sketch: top and side view, the ball's path, the power source, sizes and how each part is made

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Five criteria, weights total 50, every idea scored 1 to 5, and every criterion says what decided it.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Exactly one gap: one missing reason, one missing score, only four criteria, or weights that do not total 50.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or more of those gaps.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No table.

criterion: Score and pick (team): Weighted objectives table: 5 criteria, weights summing to 50, every idea scored, a reason on every criterion

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The reason names the winning total, or why the team overrode it; at least 3 interfaces, each naming two parts and the joint.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One of: no total in the reason, or fewer than 3 interfaces, or an interface with no joint.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Both: no total in the reason and fewer than 3 complete interfaces.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No pick.

criterion: Score and pick (team): The pick is explained by the table, and at least 3 interfaces name two parts and how they join
